stratum_row.rule:
For each cell, over the dev side (train+validation) of the fresh seal: take the
smallest cut on the recipe's own grid (`evaluate.CUT_RESOLUTION`) at which the cell would merge
at least `MIN_STRATUM_N` pairs and carries ZERO operator/gold negatives among them. No such cut
=> propose-only (`None`). "Would merge" is `ScoredRow.merged_at(cut, zone_rule=True)`: E45/E46/
E47, the E11 diversity gate and the auto-rejects all still stand, and a certificate merges
whatever the cut is (E48), so for a certificate cell the number is only the switch.
